source.description:
PROBLEM: cli/test/pi-runtime.test.ts case "copies missing extensions" exceeded Vitest default 30s during the xtrm-lk07w.16 isolated-HOME full suite. It passed immediately when rerun alone with --testTimeout=120000 but took 45.75s, confirming a load/I/O-sensitive timeout rather than assertion failure.

SUCCESS: The test has a justified bounded timeout or a faster fixture so clean full-suite runs do not fail under ordinary concurrent load.

SCOPE: cli/test/pi-runtime.test.ts test timing/fixture only.

NON_GOALS: No Pi runtime behavior changes and no blanket global timeout increase.

VALIDATION: Run the focused test repeatedly and a full isolated-HOME CLI suite; retain all content/hash assertions.
